correctness.rationale: From the hub-isolated-in-complement argument and the proved necessary-sufficient cyclic gap conditions, order-14 optimal wheel codes are exactly the 26 translates/reflections of a five-selected-rim pattern with gaps (2,2,3,2,4). Every permitted slide exchanges neighboring gap values 2 and 3 and only one such slide preserves their separation from the length-4 gap, giving 13 disjoint edges. The original-neighborhood exhaustive checker and independently programmed gap checker agree for all smaller wheels; complete finite enumeration, not heuristic sampling, certifies the first-occurrence cutoff.
